source: 657 Tizamo Town
target: 657 Oppidum Tizamo

source: Reading Madam Magician’s two choices, Lumian fell into deep thought.
target: Legens duas electiones Dominae Magicae, Lumian in profundam cogitationem cecidit.

source: These were incredible rewards!
target: Haec erant praemia incredibilia!

source: It had to be known that reaching Sequence 4 marked a crucial point for Beyonders, a moment of qualitative transformation.
target: Sciri oportuit quod ad Sequenciam IV pervenire punctum cruciale Beyonders indicaret, momentum mutationis qualitatis esset.

source: From then on, one could attain godhood and become a half-human, half-god entity.
target: Ex tunc quisque deitatem adipisci poterat atque fieri entitas semi‑humana et semi‑dea.

source: Most Beyonders would never get this far.
target: Plerique Beyonders hanc finem numquam attingere potuerunt.

source: This wasn’t just about becoming a demigod; it also included seeing or obtaining related items firsthand.
target: Hoc non solum deum semideum fieri significabat; insuper pertinebat ad ea obiecta cognata primo videre aut adipisci.

source: A Sequence 4 potion formula was usually priceless!
target: Formula potionis Sequenciae IV plerumque inestimabilis erat!

source: Moreover, this was a Sequence 4 potion formula related to Lumian’s own pathway.
target: Praeterea, haec erat formula potionis Sequenciae IV, quae ad viam propriam Lumiani pertinebat.

source: As for the reward of divining clues about the rest of the Abscessed Hand’s body, it symbolized the promise and assistance of an Angel.
target: Quoad praemium ad indaganda indicia de reliquo corpore Manus Abscessae, id repraesentabat promissionem atque auxilium Angelici.

source: Ordinary Beyonders wouldn’t even dream of such a chance, let alone receive an opportunity.
target: Beyonders vulgares talem occasionem neque quidem in somnis habebant, nedum eam adipisci.

source: They could only read about Angels gaining the Lord’s permission and responding to believers’ prayers in various Churches.
target: Solum legere poterant de Angelis qui a Domino licentiam acceperunt et preces fidelium in variis ecclesiis exsequi solet.

source: Furthermore, Lumian needed to address this issue.
target: Praeterea, Lumian hanc rem agere debebat.

source: After advancing to a Sequence 5 Reaper, his top priority was finding the remaining parts of the Abscessed Hand’s body.
target: Postquam ad Messoris Sequenciae V progressus est, primum propositum eius fuit reliquas partes corporis Manus Abscessae invenire.

source: Without completing this task, the formula, the ingredients, the digestion process, and the prepared ritual wouldn’t give him a shot at becoming a demigod in time due to the unfulfilled promise and the oath’s restrictions.
target: Nisi hoc opus perfecerit, nec formula, nec ingredienta, nec processus digestionis, nec ritus praeparatus ei occasionem dedebat deum semideum fieri in tempore propter promissionem non adimpletam et iuramenti restrictiones.

source: Regret wouldn’t even be an option.
target: Paenitentia quidem non esset consideranda.

source: Lumian had no clue how to locate it by himself.
target: Lumian plane nesciebat quomodo hoc solus invenireret.

source: His only plan was to mimic the incantation for summoning the Abscessed Hand and craft a new series of summoning incantations.
target: Unum consilium habebat: incantationem ad evocandam Manus Abscessae imitari atque novam seriem incantationum componere.

source: He hoped to summon the spirit world creature’s legs, arms, body, and head.
target: Sperabat crura, brachia, corpus, et caput creaturae mundi spirituum evocari.

source: However, this was a risky endeavor.
target: Tamen, hoc conatum periculosum erat.

source: In his dream, Lumian learned from his sister that when the summoning incantation lacked clarity and had no restrictions, the summoned entity could be unpredictable.
target: In somnio suo, Lumian a sorore sua didicit quod, cum incantatio ad evocandum obscuritatem haberet atque nullas limitationes, entitas invocata esse incerta posset.

source: It might be a demigod-level spirit world creature filled with malice, capable of killing the summoner instantly.
target: Potest esse creatura spiritus mundi in gradum semidei, malitia plena, quae evocatorem momento interficere valeat.

source: Lumian couldn’t pinpoint the precise direction due to the unknown fragmentation of the Abscessed Hand’s body.
target: Lumian directionem exactam determinare non potuit ob ignotam fragmentationem corporis Manus Abscessae.

source: It could be a relatively intact body missing a hand, or it might have shattered into tiny, peanut‑sized fragments.
target: Esse poterat corpus relative intactum, manum deesse, aut in parva fragmenta, quantitate parva, disiectum esse.

source: Describing it accurately was impossible.
target: Id accurate describere impossibile erat.

source: He could only experiment repeatedly, narrowing down the possibilities.
target: Uni poterat solum iterata experimenta facere, limites possibilitatum restringens.

source: It was akin to playing with his life.
target: Id erat quasi lusus cum vita sua.

source: More importantly, Lumian had already combed through the comprehensive information on common spirit world creatures provided by Madam Magician.
target: Praeterea, Lumian iam perlegit accuratam informationem de creaturis communibus mundi spirituum, quae Domina Magica praebebat.

source: Still, he found nothing that seemed to be other parts of the Abscessed Hand’s body.
target: Tamen nihil invenit quod altera pars corporis Manus Abscessae appareret.

source: Lumian desired the Sequence 4 Iron‑blooded Knight potion formula and clues about the rest of the Abscessed Hand’s body.
target: Lumian desiderabat formulam potionis Sequenciae IV pro equite sanguinis ferrei atque indicia de reliqua parte corporis Manus Abscessae.

source: This was the reason why he couldn’t make a decision.
target: Idcirco non potuit decisionem capere.

source: He pondered whether to teleport back to Trier now and seek Franca or Jenna’s help in divination, hoping their spiritual insights would provide him with valuable hints.
target: Cogitavit utrum nunc ad Trier teletransportari et auxilium Francae aut Jennae in divinatione quaerere vellet, sperans eorum spirituales perspicientias pretiosa indicia ei tradere.

source: As these thoughts raced through his mind, Lumian reached a decision.
target: Inter has cogitationes, Lumian consilium cepit.

source: The second option!
target: Secunda optio!

source: This was because he remembered something important.
target: Idcirco, quod aliquid magni momenti meminisse recordatus est.

source: Mr. Hanged Man’s reward had yet to materialize.
target: Praemium Domini Suspendi nondum evenit.

source: It was an opportunity to explore the Blue Avenger, a ghost ship that was a relic of the Tudor Empire.
target: Fuit occasio ut Caeruleum Vindicem, navem larvarum quae reliquiae Imperii Tudorensis erat, exploraret.

source: Considering that the Blood Emperor Alista Tudor was once a true god of the Hunter pathway and a half‑mad Red Priest, the Tudor Empire’s inheritance contained the Sequence 4 potion formula of the Hunter pathway, along with Beyonder ingredients and characteristics.
target: Considerans quod Sanguis Imperator Alista Tudor olim verus deus semitae Venatoris atque Red Priest dimidius insanus fuerit, haereditas Imperii Tudorensis continebat formulam potionis Sequenciae IV semitae Venatoris, una cum ingredientis atque proprietatibus Beyonder.

source: It was something to look forward to.
target: Id erat aliquid ad quod prospiciendum esset.

source: Lumian promptly sat down and penned a reply to Madam Magician, expressing his thoughts.
target: Lumian statim consedit et epistolam ad Dominam Magicam scripsit, suas cogitationes enuntians.

source: He also informed her that he would be heading to Tizamo Town to investigate Hisoka’s inheritance.
target: Illi etiam indicavit se ad Oppidum Tizamo properaturum esse ad hereditatem Hisoka indagandam.

source: At 4 p.m., Camus Castiya, accompanied by three dark‑brown Southern Continent natives, knocked on the door of Suite 7 on B3 of Hotel Orella.
target: Hora quarta post meridiem, Camus Castiya, comitatus tribus indigenis coloris fuscati ex Continente Meridionali, ad ianuam Suite 7 in B3 deversorii Orella pulsavit.

source: “They all hail from Tizamo, born and bred. They only ventured to Port Pylos in search of opportunities upon reaching adulthood,” Camus explained in Intisian, introducing the two men and one woman.
target: «Omnes oriundi sunt ex Tizamo, in ea nati et educati; ad Portum Pylos tantum profecti sunt, occasionum quaesitis, cum ad aetatem adultam pervenerunt», explicavit Camus in Intisiano, duo viros et unam feminam introducens.

source: “One is a supplier of Gwadar berries, another married a local and toils at the port, and the third took a less lawful path as a thief.”
target: «Unus est suppeditator bacarum Gwadar, alter locali nupta est et ad portum laborat, tertius autem viam minus legitimam, furtim agendo, secutus est.»

source: One is a relatively wealthy merchant, the other is a dockworker, and the other is a thief.
target: Unus mercator relativus dives est, alter operarius portualis, tertius vero fur.

source: They happen to be at three different social levels, and they are from both genders.
target: Conveniunt in tribus diversis gradibus socialibus, et ex utraque parte generis sunt.

source: This will allow me to understand the situation in Tizamo to the greatest extent and comprehensively.
target: Id mihi licebit ut condicionem Tizamo totam atque amplecte perscrutem.

source: Camus is very professional in this aspect.
target: Camus in hac re valde professionalem animum ostendit.

source: As expected of a former Public Security Officer… Lumian nodded slightly and asked the three subjects in fluent Dutanese, “I’m a scholar of folklore en route to Tizamo.
target: Ut ex praeterito Officeri Securitatis Publicae expectabatur… Lumian leviter annuit et tribus subiectis, lingua Dutana fluente, quaesivit: “Ego studiosus fabularum populorum sum, iter faciens ad Tizamo.

source: But before that, I’d like to learn more about the town.
target: Sed prius quam hoc, plura de oppido cognoscere velim.

source: My Dutanese is a bit rusty, so Mr. Camus will assist in translation.”
target: Lingua Dutana mea paulum rudis est, itaque Domine Camus in translatione auxilio erit.

source: “We’ll heed Officer Camus,” responded the eldest merchant with a smile, quickly seconded by the others.
target: «Audiemus Officeri Camus,» respondit mercator senior cum risu, celeriter ab aliis subnixus.

source: Lumian turned to Lugano and instructed, “I’ll take one to the master bedroom for an exchange. You can entertain the other two.”
target: Lumian ad Lugano se vertit atque imperavit: “Unum ad cubiculum principale ducam pro permutando; tu autem reliquos duos curabis.”

source: “Alright,” Lugano replied promptly.
target: “Bene,” respondit Lugano statim.

source: Inside the master bedroom, Lumian courteously seated the merchant in an armchair, positioning himself at the edge of the bed.
target: In cubiculo principali, Lumian mercatorem comiter in sellā collocavit, se ad margine lecti poni curavit.

source: Speaking in Intisian, he inquired, “What’s the primary produce of Tizamo?”
target: Lingua Intisiana loquens, quaesivit: “Quae sunt praecipua producta Tizamo?”

source: Camus, translating, wore a puzzled expression.
target: Camus, interpretans, vultum perplexum habebat.

source: Is Louis Berry truly planning a journey to Tizamo?
target: Num Louis Berry vere iter ad Tizamo parat?

source: It’s evident he’s tracing Twanaku’s footsteps!
target: Manifestum est eum vestigia Twanaku persequi!

source: Camus assumed the role of an Interrogator, staring down at the seated merchant as he conveyed Lumian’s words.
target: Camus munus Interrogatoris suscepit, mercatorem sedente aspiciens, dum verba Lumiani tradebat.

source: The merchant, filled with trepidation, responded, “Sir, we mainly cultivate Gwadar berries, spices, and forest fruits.
target: “Domine, praecipue bacas Gwadar, species aromaticae, et fructus silvarum colimus,” inquit mercator, metu repletus.

source: Numerous plantations dot the surroundings, and we often venture into the forest for hunting, selling both meat and fur.
target: Plurimae plantationes in circumstantia iacent, et saepe in silvas venandum proficiscimur, simulque carnem et pellem vendimus.

source: Additionally, we cut down trees for crafting coffins.
target: Praeterea, arbores caedimus ad sarcophaga conficienda.

source: “That’s… that’s about it.
target: “Hoc… hoc fere est—

source: The remaining effort goes into planting corn and potatoes for our own consumption.”
target: —et reliqua cura destinatur ad sementationem maizei et tuberorum pro nostra consumptione.

source: Lumian absorbed the information and refined his understanding of Dutanese through Camus’s translation.
target: Lumian notitiam sumpsit et per translationem Camusi intellectum suum linguae Dutanae consolidavit.

source: Engaging in casual conversation, Lumian explored the daily lives, sustenance, and leisure activities of the Tizamo residents.
target: In colloquio familiari, Lumian vitam cotidianam, victum atque otium incolarum Tizamo percontatus est.

source: From the merchant’s account, Lumian painted a mental picture of Tizamo.
target: Ex relatione mercatoris, Lumian imaginem animi de Tizamo confecit.

source: Its populace mainly consisted of locals, with outsiders being the proprietors of nearby plantations and some acquired slaves.
target: Populus eum constabat plerumque ex indigenis, cum externos tenerentur ut possessores plantatiorum vicinorum atque ut aliqui servorum adepti.

source: Thanks to the hunting services provided to the Port Pylos gentry, Tizamo maintained a connection with the outside world, avoiding isolation and conservativism.
target: Propter officia venandi ad nobilitatem Portus Pylos praebita, Tizamo nexum cum orbe externo retinebat, vitans segregationem et conservatismum.

source: Although the faith in Death had been eradicated, traces of it lingered in daily life.
target: Quamquam fides in Mortem deleta erat, vestigia eius in vita cotidiana manebant.

source: The townspeople primarily believed in the Eternal Blazing Sun, yet remnants of Death faith were evident, such as frequent visits to the cemetery and the practice of not burying prematurely deceased children in coffins.
target: Incolae praesertim Solem Aeternum Accendens colere solebant, attamen vestigia fidei Mortis evidentia erant, ut crebrae visitationes ad coemeteria et consuetudo puerorum praecociter defunctorum in sarcophagis sepelire non.

source: Each adult prepared a coffin for themselves in advance, and the common means of travel involved using a coffin.
target: Quisque adultus sibi sarcophagum ante praeparabat, et consuetudines itineris mediocriter in sarcophago usui erant.

source: With keen interest, Lumian concluded the discussion and inquired, “Are you familiar with Twanaku Tupián?”
target: Lumian, cum studio flagranti, sermonem concludens interrogavit: “Scitisne Twanaku Tupián?”

source: Finally getting into the meat… Camus exhaled quietly and conveyed the question to the merchant.
target: Postremo in rem intrante… Camus quiete suspiravit et quaestionem mercatori pronuntiavit.

source: A warm smile appeared on the merchant’s face.
target: Super faciem mercatoris risus calidus apparuit.

source: “I do! He’s well‑known in town.”
target: «Scio! Ille in oppido notus est.»

source: “Why?” Camus interjected.
target: “Cur?” inquit Camus.

source: The merchant, with an obsequious smile, responded, “Sir, he should be your colleague.
target: Mercator, risu obsequioso ornatus, respondit: “Domine, ille tibi collegae esse oportet.

source: Twanaku is the first person from Tizamo to join the patrol team.
target: Twanaku primus ex Tizamo est qui ad turmae custodiae accessit.

source: Moreover, he’s rapidly advancing in rank.
target: Praeterea, celeriter in gradu ascendit.

source: He’s a source of pride for us.”
target: Ipse nobis decus est.”

source: Lumian couldn’t help but emit a soft chuckle.
target: Lumian non potuit quin lenem risum edideret.

source: “I’m quite curious about Twanaku’s past.”
target: “Valde curiosus sum de praeteritis Twanaku.”

source: The merchant’s expression shifted slightly as he glanced around.
target: Vultus mercatoris paulum commutatus est, dum circumdabat.

source: “Sirs, did Twanaku commit a crime?
target: “Domini, num Twanaku scelus commisit?

source: Did he join an organization that believes in Death?”
target: Num se ad ordinationem, quae Mortem credit, contulit?”

source: Quite perceptive… Lumian thought, while Camus grumbled in a low voice, “Are we doing the questioning or are you? Just answer truthfully!”
target: Perceptive quidem… Lumian cogitabat, dum Camus voce humili submurmurabat: “Nosne interrogationem facimus aut tu? Sine mendacio responde!”

source: Under the mental pressure of the Interrogator, the dark‑skinned merchant replied with a trembling voice, “I’ve known for a long time that this young man, Twanaku, will surely become extraordinary, but I also know he’ll one day tread the path of blasphemy against a deity.”
target: Sub impetu mentis a Interrogatore, mercator obscura cutis voce tremula respondit: “Iam diu sciebam hunc iuvenem, Twanaku, certe eximium futurum esse, sed etiam scio eum aliquando iter blasphemicum adversus deum percurrere.”

source: Seeing Camus and Lumian awaiting further explanation, the merchant continued, “There was a fire in the Twanaku family.
target: Videntes Camum et Lumian ulteriora explananda exspectantes, mercator perrexit: “Fuit ignis in familia Twanaku.

source: All his kin perished, and only he survived.
target: Omnes cognati eius perierunt, solus ipse superfuit.

source: According to our customs, he’s favored by a deity, spared from death.
target: Secundum consuetudines nostras, a deitate favente, a morte liberatus est.

source: Such individuals often go on to achieve great feats.”
target: Tales saepe ad res magnas adipisci tendunt.

source: The deity’s favor refers to Death here, right?
target: Num hic beneficium divinitatis ad Mortem refertur, nonne?

source: Not succumbing to Death is considered receiving Death’s favor?
target: Non succumbere Morte, id quidem reputatur ut Mortis favorem accipere.

source: Lumian interjected thoughtfully.
target: Lumian, meditabundus, interposuit.

source: “The fire happened about six years ago?”
target: “Ignis ante circiter sex annos accidit?”

source: “How did you know?” the surprised merchant asked.
target: “Quomodo novisti?” inquit mercator obstupefactus.

source: Then, slapping his forehead, he added, “I’m such a fool.
target: Deinde, frontem pulsans, addidit: “Ego tam stultus sum.

source: You must have investigated it beforehand.”
target: “Id prius perscrutari tibi oportuit.”

source: From the looks of it, the fire somehow brought Twanaku back to life, transforming him into Hisoka…
target: Ex prospectu videtur ignis aliquo modo Twanaku in vitam revocasse, eum in Hisoka transformans…

source: Lumian nodded.
target: Lumian annuit.

source: “Continue.”
target: “Perge.”

source: Recalling, the merchant said, “Since then, Twanaku fell silent, as if in shock.
target: Meminens, mercator dixit: “Ex illo tempore, Twanaku in silentium cecidit, quasi stupens.

source: He no longer participated in Mass or entered the cathedral of God.
target: Iam nec in Missa participavit nec in cathedralem Dei intravit.

source: Later, he left Tizamo for Port Pylos.”
target: Postea Tizamo relictus ad Portum Pylos se contulit.

source: Was Twanaku unafraid of scrutiny for acting so unusually?
target: Num Twanaku investigationem non timebat, ob tam insolitam agendi rationem?

source: Did he not bother to feign his faith?
target: Num fidem suam simulare negligebat?

source: By then, Hisoka had already become a Beyonder of the Devil pathway, making it impossible for him to participate in the Eternal Blazing Sun Church’s Mass?
target: Iam Hisoka factus erat Beyonder semitae Diaboli, quod ei impossibilis reddebat participationem in Missa Ecclesiae Solis Aeterni Ardenti?

source: Where did his first potion come from?
target: Unde prima pocio eius orta est?

source: Lumian pondered while Camus translated and asked, “Does Twanaku frequently return to Tizamo?”
target: Lumian cogitabat, dum Camus interpretatus est, et quaesivit: “Num Twanaku saepe ad Tizamo revertitur?”

source: “He comes back to Tizamo every year.
target: “Quotannis ad Tizamo redit—

source: “I’m not sure how often or for how long,” the merchant truthfully replied.
target: —‘Nescio quotiens nec per quamdiu,’ respondit mercator sincere.

source: “Where does he stay when he returns to Tizamo?” Lumian inquired further.
target: “Ubi manet cum ad Tizamo revertitur?” interrogavit Lumian ulterius.

source: The merchant smoothly replied, “At his own place.
target: Mercator leniter respondit: “In domo sua.

source: After joining the patrol team and amassing wealth, he rebuilt the burnt‑down house.”
target: Postquam turmae custodiae se adiunxit et copias collexit, domum incensam refecit.

source: Rebuilt the house that was destroyed in the fire…
target: Domum, quae igne deleta erat, refecit…

source: Lumian contemplated for a moment and then asked, “Are there any special folklore festivals in Tizamo?”
target: Lumian paulisper meditatus deinde interrogavit: “Suntne quaedam festalia specialia fabularum populorum in Tizamo?”
